课程简介（中文）

本课程将使金融学学生了解近年来中国金融创新的典型代表：供应链金融的基本原理商业模式，以及区块链、比特币与数字货币相关内容，本课程主要授课内容包括供应链管理基础、供应链金融产生的历程、国内外理论和实践的差异、供应链金融构架及其原理、相关的供应链金融模式组合和风险管理，供应链金融业态，在线供应链金融，供应链金融ABS等，区块链、比特币与数字货币的来源及其发展历程,人民币数字货币等，并根据所学知识开展理论和实践创新研究。为学生认知金融创新服务于实体经济发展，为中国产业升级创新创造更加便利的融资方式。

课程简介（英文）

This course will enable the students understand the typical representative of Chinese financial innovation in recent years, the basic principles of supply chain finance and its operation mechanism, Blockchain, Bitcoin and digital currencies. This course mainly includes the basics of supply chain management; the history of supply chain finance; The differences between domestic and foreign theories and practices; the framework of supply chain finance and its principles; the relevant supply chain finance model combination and risk management; supply chain finance format; online supply chain finance; supply chain finance ABS,Blockchain, Bitcoin and digital currencies etc., and carry out theoretical and practical innovation research according to the knowledge learned. This course is created to recognize financial innovation for students to serve the development of the real economy, and to create a more convenient financing method for China's industrial upgrading and innovation.

教学目标

本课程将使金融学学生了解近年来中国金融创新的典型代表：供应链金融的基本原理商业模式，供应链金融在支持实体经济，创新性服务中小微普惠金融领域的功能及其方式，以及区块链比特币与人民币数字货币相关金融创新内容。
